environmentNotes: Electron runs launched through scripts/run-headless.mjs (xvfb, Wayland stripped), ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE unset; main and host reported process.versions.electron=44.0.0, host process.type=utility, ozone x11.
A parallel EI-1a headless Electron spike was running on the same machine during most Electron timings; absolute ms carry that CPU contention.

q1_wasmInitUtilityProcess.entryShape: ESM entry, body inside functions, no top-level await; config over process.parentPort
q1_wasmInitUtilityProcess.wasmLoadPath: bundle fetches new URL("data:application/wasm;base64,...") through globalThis.fetch; utilityProcess has no WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming, glue falls back to WebAssembly.instantiate (no shim needed)
shimsNeeded: REQUIRED: globalThis.WorkerGlobalScope with Symbol.hasInstance(o => o === globalThis). Without it the first consensus-side fetch that throws (offline, DNS failure, allowlist refusal, blocked redirect, connection refused) panics in zduny-wasm-timer ("no supported global object available: Object { obj: JsValue(global) }") and kills Helios: measured in plain Node and in the Electron 44 utility process
egress guard must let data:application/wasm through fetch
EIP-1193 wrapper mapping Helios revert strings to {code:3,data} for viem CCIP-Read (see q6)
q1_wasmInitUtilityProcess.utilitySandbox: the forked NodeService utility runs with --service-sandbox-type=none

q2_firstWindow.method: main creates BrowserWindow(show:false) + loadFile; modes: nohost, host (fork right after window creation), host-after-show (fork on ready-to-show). 10 ms interval lag sampler in main, bucketed by phase.
q2_firstWindow.conclusion: No measurable delay to ready-to-show. The ~200 ms main-loop stall is window creation itself (present in nohost). Forked after ready-to-show, WASM init + sync cost main <= 11 ms.

q3_sync.agreementNote: publicnode and Nimbus returned the same root for every slot; Lodestar agreed where it answered (13, 15, 45, 90, 160 days) and 404ed headers-by-slot for 1, 10, 25 days but served every bootstrap.

badcp.syncError: sync failed: invalid sync committee period

q3_sync.pastAgeLimit: No warning, no error, no console output at 25, 45 or 160 days; all synced. helios-ts 0.11.1 builds Config with ..Default::default(), so max_checkpoint_age=0 and strict_checkpoint_age=false; the only age check (consensus.rs:544-551) is tracing::warn!("checkpoint too old, consider using a more recent block"), which never surfaces in the WASM build. Orivon must enforce the age itself.
q3_sync.noCheckpoint: Helios silently uses its baked default root 0x9b41a80f58c52068a00e8535b8d6704769c7577a5fd506af5e0c018687991d55 (slot 12704096, ~2025-10-01, ~359 days old) and syncs forward 315 periods (9.4 s; one later run failed with "sync failed: invalid sync committee period"). The ethpandaops list is NOT contacted.
q3_sync.malformedCheckpoint: A 63-hex-digit checkpoint fails B256::from_hex and silently falls back to the same baked default (helios-ts ethereum.rs: .and_then(|c| B256::from_hex(c).ok()).unwrap_or(base.default_checkpoint)). Orivon must validate ^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$ itself.
q3_sync.dbTypeNote: In the JS build the checkpoint is always Some(..), so db.load_checkpoint() is never read; Orivon must persist and pass the checkpoint itself.

q4_egress.guard: globalThis.fetch replaced before Helios import (origin allowlist, redirect:"error", data:application/wasm allowed); XMLHttpRequest/WebSocket/EventSource replaced by throwing stubs; net.Socket.prototype.connect logged independently.
q4_egress.otherNetworkApisUsedByHelios: none: no XMLHttpRequest/WebSocket/EventSource call, and every TCP connect went to a configured host (WebSocket global exists in Node 24 and in the utility process, so the guard must replace it).
